source_en: Finishing a commissioned portrait.
Pharmacy, then gallery storeroom. Home.
Picking up fresh canvases.
Three pharmacies. Got half. Home.
To my studio. The violet won't wait.
Home for charcoal. The light is changing.
To my studio roof. The light is dying.
Home to finish my final canvas.
Mandatory resident census.
Home from my bank shift. Numbers all day.
Home to care for my grandmother.
Selling my paints. I quit years ago.
Threw my pills away. Never needed them.
Going to sleep. Colours bore me.
Back from engineering night classes.
Home to rest. Light doesn't matter.
Collecting my post office pension.
Going home to burn my sketchbooks.
My documents. Sorry about the charcoal smudges.
The shadows across your booth are quite striking today.
The sky is a violet that shouldn't exist. Have you noticed?
Hurry, please. The horizon is melting. I must paint it.
The world is finally becoming the abstract piece I dreamed of.
Out of red paint. The sunset provides plenty.
Here. She sets the papers down without looking.
You want something. Everyone does.
She does not speak. She just watches you.
The papers are down before you ask.
Take them. She has not blinked in some time.
She stands very still. Waiting. Too long.
Stay in the light. Better composition there.
Good luck. Watch the colours. They're starting to bleed.
I'll see you in the masterpiece. Don't blink.
A white room with good lighting? Fine. Absolutely fine.
Great artists all get imprisoned. Very on-brand.
I hadn’t signed the last canvas… It needed one more pass…
All that light and I never… quite captured it…
Where are you coming from?
The pharmacy, then the gallery storeroom. Does order matter?
Three pharmacies. Got half my prescription. Half will do.
My studio roof. The light is dying. Someone must record it.
The textile looms. Painting never paid, so I quit.
Aspirin for a neighbour. I've never needed a prescription.
The train station. I only arrived here this morning.
Somewhere. It is not relevant.
I do not remember. The walk was long.
She considers it for too long. I do not know.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
A managed condition. Tamar sees to it mornings. That's all.
Pills are scarce. My hands tremble. Charcoal hides it.
Tired. Colours hurt my eyes. There isn't much time.
Nothing. I've never had a condition. Nobody checks on me.
None. Clean hands, look. Charcoal ruins the skin.
My eyes? Perfect. I haven't painted in years.
No symptoms. Nothing left to be symptomatic of.
I used to feel cold. Not anymore. Write that down.
She tilts her head. That question no longer applies.
You have a good face for charcoal. Very strong lines.
The smog makes everything amber. Almost worth it.
That violet sky should not exist. I'm obsessed.
Almost out of yellow. I don't think I need it now.
Almost out of red. The sky keeps giving me reference.
You're the most interesting face I've drawn in ages.
The face behind the mask is less interesting than you think.
You are very loud. Your breathing.
There is nothing behind the mask. As you suspected.
